validation.settingsChange: The original reachable-set objective, weight box and physical benchmark are retained. The nonlinear cases use documented finite-difference and conditioning settings; the linear test uses GPS. The selected methods are GPSPositiveBasis2N for the linear reference and fmincon active-set with central differences for nonlinear cases. Exact saved initial weights are supplied. The iteration limit is 250 per solver (outer iterations for GPS), with 100000 objective evaluations. GPS uses InitialMeshSize=1, InitialPenalty=1e3 and ScaleMesh=false. Nonlinear active-set function/step/constraint tolerances are 1e-6, with central relative step eps^(1/3) and a 1800-second callback guard. ScaleProblem is not applicable to this active-set run. The original objective is unscaled. The linear GPS reference retains its 1e-6 mesh/function/step/constraint settings. Time-stop exits are not accepted. These are new solver criteria, not a claim of unchanged SQP defaults or differentiable stationarity. Global Optimization Toolbox is required. Earlier attempts remain downloadable. Nonlinear callbacks share a reach computation, checked against the original separate functions at three deterministic probes and independently rechecked at the final point. The accepted records used four workers. The linear reference uses original callbacks; nonlinear callbacks share the reach computation. The nonlinear solver seed is reset to 20261019 after initialization and evaluation audits. The portable setup uses four workers.
